title: Murray-Darling Basin Commission of Inquiry Bill 2019
short_title: Murray-Darling Basin Commission of Inquiry Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would create a panel to examine problems in the Murray-Darling Basin.
The panel would look into wrongdoing, the rules for the Basin Plan, effects on the environment and farming, and climate change impacts.
The bill follows a South Australian royal commission that was hampered by other governments not cooperating.
changes: The bill would set up a commission of inquiry.
The inquiry would investigate misconduct and the legislative framework for the Basin Plan.
It would examine the plan's environmental, agricultural and community effects.
It would look at how funds for the Basin Plan were spent and their impact on environmental watering.
It would also assess climate change effects on water resources and adaptation measures.
summary.affected: The inquiry would affect the Murray-Darling Basin, its environment, agriculture, river communities, and governments involved in water management.
